system.senses: Spots movement within 6 squares in line of sight.
system.passive: Usually hired by someone who knew a heist was possible. Patrols actively.
system.escalation: Aware the moment it spots the crew: +1 Alert (its “spotted,” not an extra), then +1 a round, and it follows the crew. Aware lasts the heist, unless it's paid off.
system.weakness: Bribery (the crew must produce something valuable on the spot), the Grifter's Decoy (works once), the Bruiser (works, but loudly — and a beaten guard calls for backup: a fresh one, already aware, takes its post).
system.notes:
Note: cannot be charmed by the Face — professional courtesy. Fast Talk and Deception still work.

Note: guard spiders aren't evil. They're working. Anyone but the Face could try talking to one. The Difficulty is 4. Worth one attempt.
system.biography:
“Professional. Unfortunately.”

Another spider, usually hired by someone who knew a heist was possible. It knows what you are and what you're doing, and it is simply working.
